description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 55 (Mannar) for the Allotments of Land in Mundampiddy, Mantai west D/S Division, Mannar District in Topo P. P. No. 23 (North)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land settlement matters under the Land Settlement Ordinance, including final orders and amendments to land settlement records. It contains detailed schedules specifying land lots, extents, and settlement to the State, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
